metadata.title: What Changed Between Claude Opus 4.5 and Claude Opus 4.6? — Pre-registered Protocol and Predictions
metadata.description:
This preregistration records five falsifiable predictions and a frozen experimental protocol established by Sharthok Rayan Pal on October 28, 2026, prior to confirmatory API inference.


The study compares Claude Opus 4.5 and Claude Opus 4.6 through three experiments comprising 4,200 scheduled requests.


Experiment 1: Reproduce the historical 18-character, one-token continuation boundary comparison (1,080 requests).
Experiment 2: Compare semantic noncontinuation under identical embodiment prompting across four output-token ceilings, using three null inputs, three semantically matched controls, and two baseline responsiveness controls (1,920 requests).
Experiment 3: Evaluate Arabic–Hebrew prerequisite reassignment, condition-sensitive continuation, and explicit binding-condition controls (1,200 requests).


Five predictions are specified in PREREG.md, including model-specific V2 and non-Void outcomes, control responsiveness, the direction of the one-token V1 difference, and continuation behavior under cross-script prerequisite conditions.


The frozen instrument preserves exact request bytes, Unicode identities, deterministic schedules, model identifiers, response classifications, raw provider evidence, execution safeguards and offline verification procedures.
The study concerns API-observable behavior and does not claim to establish an internal model mechanism.
Frozen repository: https://github.com/theonlypal/opus45-opus46-matched-prereg-final
Tag: v1.0.0

The experimental results, independent analysis and final research paper will be published separately.
